claims.evidence: Witness could only identify a generic white game console; no model markings, logos, or labels were read from the photo to confirm Sony branding or Pro variant.
No power-on, boot screen, or benchmark shown; marketing language cannot be checked from a static photo.

risks.risk: Console may not be a PS4 Pro at all (could be base PS4, PS4 Slim, or unbranded unit)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear/bottom label showing model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro) and Sony/PlayStation branding
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/generic console, not as PS4 Pro

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults
risks.proof: Video of console powering on to the home/dashboard screen
Photo of system storage settings screen or capacity sticker on unit

risks.risk: Region/version unknown (affects disc compatibility and resale)
risks.proof: Photo of region sticker or system settings region info

risks.risk: Only third-party 'X6' wireless controllers shown, not an original DualShock
risks.proof: Photo of the actual controller that comes bundled, with brand markings visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, aftermarket controllers valued separately at low aftermarket price

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition (scratches, dents, yellowing) not shown from all angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of top, bottom, and vents of the console

risks.risk: Missing essential cables (HDMI) for actual use
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle including HDMI cable
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, HDMI cable cost added separately

risks.risk: Port/internal component condition (HDMI port, disc drive) unverifiable remotely
risks.proof: Video showing disc insertion/ejection and HDMI port close-up
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified functionality, worst case assumed

proof_requests: Photo of the rear/bottom label showing exact model number and branding
Video of the console powering on to the dashboard
Photo of system storage and region settings
Close-up photos of top, bottom, and port areas for wear/damage
Photo of the actual bundled controller(s), not just the boxed ones
Photo of full accessory set including any HDMI cable
response.reason: The witness confirms only a generic white game console with third-party controller boxes; the seller's PS4 Pro claim is unverified, so it must be priced at the worst case of an unconfirmed/generic console with unproven function and accessories until model, power-on, and condition proofs are supplied.
